definitions.explanation: A line made up of a series of dots or short dashes. Used in diagrams, maps, forms, and documents to indicate boundaries, cutting lines, or areas to fill in.

examples.japanese: {点線|てんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please cut along the dotted line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{点線|てんせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{境|さかい}→境：02822_sakai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}している→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: The dotted line on the map indicates the prefectural boundary.

examples.japanese: {点線|てんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write your name and address on the dotted line.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen on forms, coupons, and craft instructions. The phrase {点線|てんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (cut along the dotted line) is one of the most frequent collocations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {点線|てんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut along the dotted line)
- {点線|てんせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧ (to enclose with a dotted line)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実線|じっせん}→実線：20763_jissen⟧: solid line — a continuous, unbroken line
- ⟦{波線|なみせん}→波線：18331_namisen⟧: wavy line
- ⟦{破線|はせん}→破線：20764_hasen⟧: dashed line — technically distinct from dotted line, but often used interchangeably
